c74object.name: gst.clock
c74object.digest: Master clock for multiple IMU receiver modules
c74object.description: gst.clock is master clock for multiple IMU receiver modules. Receiver modules such as gst.riot or gst.riot-comote use their own posible clock type : similar to [bang] messages evaluating tasks of objects. Therefore data could be potentialy processed on different thread of the Max scheduler. Having several IMU receiver modules requires a master clock to ensure that all datas are treated in the same thread : synchronized processes because of mode of all previously instantiated receiver modules. gst.clock uses internal send/receive to spread frameperiod, framerate and sync messages.

inlet.description:
start 0/1 [int] turns on/off the clock
framerate [float] sets the frame rate in Hz.
frameperiod [float] sets the frame period in ms.
usual internal frame period of IMU are 5, 10 or 20 ms.

inlet.digest: sets all instanciated receiver modules in external mode

attribute.name: clocktype
attribute.description:
metro clock is high priority [bang] message generator at a specified interval of time (ms)
qmetro clock is low-priority queue [bang] message generator at a specified interval of time (ms)

attribute.name: framerate
attribute.description: frame rate [float] in Hz for all "gst" processes.

attribute.name: frameperiod
attribute.description: frame period [float] in ms for all "gst" processes.
